name: io.github.shaag7967/mcp-server-senseca-pro
title: Senseca PRO thermometer
description: Live readings from Senseca PRO 111/115 Pt100 thermometers via USB (unofficial)

environmentVariables.name: SENSECA_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serial port of the instrument, e.g. /dev/ttyACM0 or COM3. Auto-detected if not set.

environmentVariables.name: SENSECA_PIN
environmentVariables.description: Instrument PIN, only needed if its protected mode is enabled

environmentVariables.name: SENSECA_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable tools that change instrument settings (clock, location labels)
